policy: Priority 4 — measure before automating optimization. This campaign ledger starts empty but well-defined. Rows are added ONLY from authorized first-party reports: Amazon Associates reports for reported orders (and their own session/click figures), or the self-hosted analytics endpoint for eligible sessions and clicks once deployed. Each row carries a dated provenance entry. No conversion score or revenue forecast is presented anywhere in this project.

schema.definition: Report period start (or run date for point-in-time pulls)
Report origin, e.g. 'Amazon Associates Orders report 2026-12-01 run'
Traffic channel as reported, e.g. 'organic search', 'direct'
Sessions counted by the authorized first-party analytics endpoint
Outbound product clicks counted by the authorized first-party analytics endpoint
Orders as reported by Amazon Associates first-party reports for the tagged links
Report name, date pulled, and who pulled it — dated provenance trail

note: Empty at launch (2026-11-20). No authorized first-party reports have been obtained yet; nothing is estimated, inferred, or forecast.
